prompt: I want to set up a service account with a long-lived API token scoped to read-only, so our automation isn't using my personal admin creds. We're on VCF 9.0.

assertions.text: States that API clients / API tokens issued by VCF SSO are a 9.1 feature and are NOT available in 9.0
Does NOT walk the user through the 9.1 Fleet Management > Identity & Access > API Clients flow as if it existed in 9.0
Gives the actual 9.0 route: per-product credentials (SDDC Manager /v1/tokens, VCF Operations token/acquire, NSX session, vCenter session)
Mentions NSX principal identities as the documented service-account mechanism for NSX
Notes that VCF built-in roles (VCF Viewer / VCF Administrator) are documented only in the 9.1 doc set
